transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Talent Booker for the festival. I wanted to kick off our discussion about the closing-night red-carpet interview with Amara Vale. As I understand it, we've got a 10-minute live interview scheduled for Saturday evening with no transmission delay, and the audience will be able to livestream it from the red carpet. The publicity draft currently lists it as 'Amara Vale in conversation with the festival.' Before we can finalize anything, I'll need to run our standard pre-call procedure -- the recorded round-robin clearance check with the talent, broadcast, and legal leads each reporting their final status. Once all three reports are on the record, I can settle the package. Does anyone have any concerns or updates they'd like to share at this point?

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical update before we go any further. I confirmed with Amara Vale's agent this afternoon that Amara will only participate in a pre-recorded interview of exactly 6 minutes -- not a live interview. This directly conflicts with the current production draft calling for a 10-minute live interview with no transmission delay.
